thread:
Iris (Billing): Quick one 9 Lumen Labs (LL-304) disputed April invoice 101213. They were charged full onboarding fees though Sales approved a one-time onboarding rebate in their MSA. They want a credit. I attached the signed MSA.

billing-bot: Audit results: invoice=101213 missing_rebate MS-LL-ONB. Suggested remediation: (A) post account credit of $3,600 with memo 'Onboarding rebate - Lumen', or (B) issue card refund per customer request. Note: rebates flagged as manual in billing system.

Dev (CS): Customer prefers credit to their account; accounting says that will work for reconciliation but asks for formal memo on ledger. They also want assurance this won't affect next month's invoice.

Noel (Revenue Ops): For revenue recognition we can post a contra-revenue credit memo CM-101213-ONB 3600 and note contract ref. No problem. If we do card refund we'd need Finance Lead approval for >$1k.

Iris (Billing): Drafted CM: `CM-101213-ONB` amount $3,600. Setting status pending_post. Do we have signoff to post? Also will add account tag 'manual-rebate-applied' to prevent double-apply.

Harper (Finance Lead): Approved. Post the credit memo and update ledger with entry JV-2026-301. Please include memo: 'One-time onboarding rebate per MSA LL-304, approver Harper (Finance Lead)'.

Sia (Legal): ACK. Please attach the signed MSA and the customer's written acceptance of credit to the case file for audit trail. Also note we should not default this rebate for other accounts without Pricing approval.

Iris (Billing): Posted CM-101213-ONB. Ledger JV-2026-301 created. Updated account tag and added ticket BO-1589 for Pricing to review if onboarding rebates should be standardized. Notifying CS for customer message.

Dev (CS): Informed customer; they replied "Thanks, confirmed receipt of credit and closing dispute." Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
